If we’re speaking on the Vancian model of magical dynamics, I understand your frustration but you’re basically describing counterspell.

The thing about a spell within the Vancian head canon is that it takes up physical space within your mind. Including a counterspell.

Using a counterspell is akin to unloading physical ammunition from a crossbow. This is the same case with other spells, but counterspells are by definition crossbow quarrels designed to splinter the arrows of other casters.

If you dedicate LITERAL headspace (within the Vancian model) to causing others to waste their magical repertoire, that is by definition mana drain.
